summary: Frontend-only verification of SB Drive VTC duplicate-tile removal and orange page-chrome fixes. All 6 assertions PASS. Logged in as rider.i18n@demo.sb via /login/email; Home 'Services Taxi' shows exactly the 8 canonical tiles (Taxi VTC, Pool-partage, Moto Taxi, Électric, Planifiez votre trajet, Mise à Dispo, Intercité, Tous les Taxis) with ZERO forbidden duplicates ('VTC Réservation', 'VTC Pooling', 'VTC Location', 'Enchères VTC', 'VTC Intercity', 'Programmer Course' all absent). Tapping 'Tous les Taxis' → /taxi hub 'Choisissez un service' with the 3 groups (Au quotidien / Temps & Distance / Spécialisé & Inclusif). Direct nav to /more-taxi REDIRECTS to /taxi (final URL ends with /taxi, no 'Plus de Services VTC' title present). On /course?mode=standard the 'Utiliser ma position actuelle' button text color computes to rgb(255, 80, 0) = #FF5000. No error overlay, no 'is not a constructor' console errors, no unrelated console errors detected during the test.
critical_code_review_comments: UserHome.js is 696 lines — getting large. Consider extracting the per-section service tile arrays (taxi/delivery/beauty/pet/carcare/towing/nearby) into a separate /pages/user/userHomeServices.js to keep the page <500 lines and improve readability.
